data.gender_notes: Katherine is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name Aikaterine, which means pure or clear. In the New Testament, Saint Catherine of Alexandria was a renowned martyr and is considered the patron saint of scholars and students. Her name has been a popular choice among Christians due to her connection to purity and knowledge. The name Katherine carries the meaning “Pure, Clear” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Katherine usually hope their child will grow to embody pure, clear and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of spiritual enlightenment and clarity.
data.etymology: Katherine belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Pure, Clear.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Katherine total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_hebrew.name: קתרינה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם קתרינה נגזר מהשם היווני 'Αἰκατερίνη' (Aikaterinē), שפירושו 'טוהר'. השם קתרינה הוא שם נוצרי שמקורו ביוונית ומשמעותו היא טוהר וזוהר לנצח. השם נמצא בשימוש נרחב במסורת הנוצרית והוא שם של קדושת נוצרית חשובה.

in_greek.name: Αἰκατερίνη
in_greek.long_meaning: Τὸ ὄνομα Αἰκατερίνη προέρχεται ἀπὸ τὸν ὑψίστο καιρό της χριστιανικῆς εποχής. Ἡ λέξη Aikaterinē σημαίνει 'καθαρή' καὶ συνδέεται μὲ τὴν πνευματικὴ καθαρότητα καὶ τὴν αἰώνια λαμπρότητα ποὺ προσφέρει ἡ χριστιανικὴ πίστη.

in_latin.name: Catherina
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Catherina origine Graeco, sed in latinitate usitatum, significat puritatem et claritatem. In traditione christiana, Catherina est nomen sanctae martyris et philosophiae, quae pro fide sua in saeculo IV coronam martyrii adeptus est.

in_english.name: Katherine

When given to a child, the name Katherine conveys a deep sense of spiritual meaning and encourages a life of learning and purity.
